quests.conceptTitle: Perspective Rotator: Voice Choice - Active Preferred

quests.ruleExplanation: Marie Curie is the doer of discovered, and active voice is the natural choice here because the whole point of the sentence is to credit her - passive would bury the very information that matters most. A passive version, Two new elements were discovered by Marie Curie, technically works but weakens the focus on her achievement.
quests.nativeTip: Here the doer is exactly what makes the sentence worth saying. Find her right before discovered.
quests.visualAnchor: 🔄 Active: Marie Curie discovered two new elements, polonium and radium. ⇄ Passive: Two new elements, polonium and radium, were discovered by Marie Curie.
